meta.title: Curated Lens | Discover the Stories Around You
meta.description: A hill is just a hill until you know its story. Curated Lens is the AI-powered location storytelling platform that reveals points of interest, history, and experiences for premium travelers.

landing.subtitle: Location-aware storytelling that reveals the meaning behind every landmark.

route.title: Geo-Bounded Corridor
route.description: Define your exact route on a map. The AI scans only within your corridor, ensuring every story is relevant.
route.voice: Draw the path your ship sails, and we'll find every story along the way.

poi.title: POI Discovery Engine
poi.description: Automated ingestion scans your corridor for castles, vineyards, villages, and landmarks.
poi.voice: The system discovers every point of interest your guests will wonder about.

content.title: Content Baking Engine
content.description: Four tiers: Quick Facts, Narrative Summaries, Deep Dives, and Panoramic overlays. All pre-baked.
content.voice: From quick facts to cinematic deep-dives, every tier is pre-baked and ready.

tone.title: Tone Calibration
tone.description: Slide between Formal Historian and Branded Luxury. Your brand voice infuses every word.
tone.voice: Dial in your brand's voice — from scholarly to indulgent.

review.title: Human Review Gate
review.description: Nothing goes live without your explicit approval. Flag, edit, or approve every piece of content.
review.voice: Nothing reaches your guests without your seal of approval.

publish.title: Publication Hub
publish.description: One-click publishing generates QR codes, web links, and offline packages instantly.
publish.voice: One click. Every channel. Instantly live.

terminal.cmd1: > Compiling route data for Rhine Valley...

discovery.heading: A Castle Appears on the Horizon
discovery.body: As the Rhine curves north past Braubach, a medieval silhouette rises above the tree line. Most guests glance up, then return to their drinks. Curated Lens ensures they never miss the story.

stat.label: Avg. time to first POI tap

detection.heading: The Platform Recognises Every Landmark
detection.body: GPS cross-referenced against our 40,000-entry POI database. Marksburg Castle, Loreley Rock, and 6 other landmarks pinned and ready within 200ms of entering range.

story.heading: Marksburg Castle — The Story Unfolds
story.body: Built in 1117, Marksburg is the only Rhine fortress never destroyed in warfare. Guests tap the notification and receive a rich narrative — history, architecture, legend — at exactly the right moment.

panoramic.heading: The Full Landscape, Annotated
panoramic.body: Rotate the phone to landscape and the view transforms into an annotated panoramic layer. Every feature of the horizon named, every story accessible with a tap.

local.heading: Beyond Sightseeing — Real Experiences
local.body: Curated Lens surfaces curated local recommendations: the Riesling estate 400m from the dock, the family-run restaurant serving regional specialties since 1892.

phoneUi.rieslingDesc: Award-winning Riesling estate, open for tastings.

phaseConclusion.ctaEyebrow: Ready to Transform Your Guest Experience?
phaseConclusion.ctaHeading1: A Hill Is Just a Hill
phaseConclusion.ctaBody: Join Viking, Scenic, and other premium operators who use Curated Lens to transform passive sightseeing into real-time location storytelling.
phaseConclusion.voiceInsights: See what your guests truly cared about, and use it to improve every future voyage.
